name: Warm Berry Medley with Walnut Streusel Topping & Vanilla Ice Cream

instructions.primary_message: Melt butter in a small saucepan set over medium heat.
Meanwhile, roughly chop walnuts. Place in a small bowl along with flour, sugar, and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup walnuts
granulated sugar
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the butter is melted, drizzle into the bowl with the flour. Use a fork to stir and combine the streusel topping into rough, sandy clumps (it should be combined but not even). (Reserve saucepan for later use.)

Transfer streusel mixture to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until streusel is golden brown and crisp, 6-8 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
While the streusel is baking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lime
1 (170 g) pkg raspberries
1 (170 g) pkg blackberries

instructions.primary_message: Return saucepan to medium heat. Juice lime into the pan, then add raspberries, blackberries, and additional sugar. Cook, stirring occasionally, until berries are juicy and starting to break down, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide berries and ice cream between bowls; top with walnut streusel. Enjoy!
